data.text: Definitely getting concerned about the storm surge threat in Baler Bay. Huge waves from Typhoon Fung-wong (UwanPH) are already crashing into the Aurora coastline of Luzon, and if the storm makes landfall just south of the bay, it could push a dangerous flow of seawater directly into Baler. Widespread reports are also indicating that substantial freshwater flash flooding is ongoing in multiple locations. Conditions across the northern Philippines will only continue to get worse from here on out.

data.text: Crazy footage below of fierce, near-whiteout winds and severe flooding in the city of Virac on Catanduanes. The island became fully consumed in the Category 3 eyewall of Typhoon Fung-wong (UwanPH) over the last few hours as the marauding storm passed by to the north. Calabarzon and the Aurora coast of Luzon are now in line for Fung-wong’s ultimate, direct landfall into the Philippines.

#MSNews | Personnel of the Catbalogan City Fire Station retrieved a cadaver trapped beneath the debris of her destroyed residence at Pier 2, Barangay 3, Catbalogan City, following the devastation brought by Super Typhoon "Uwan."

Upon receiving the report, BFP Catbalogan immediately dispatched a response team to the area to conduct search and retrieval operations.

"We continue to stand in solidarity with all those affected by the recent typhoon and remain committed to providing assistance and emergency response to our fellow Catbalogans in this time of crisis," the Catbalogan Fire Station said in their statement. | via Vince Lopez

📷 Catbalogan City Fire Station
